title: Localized pure-tensor extensionality for a single tensor internal Hom
statement: Let (C,J) be a site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and A,B,N,X sheaves of R-modules. Use the internal Hom, tensor and section map from [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise]. Let a,b:X→internalHom(A tensor B,N). Suppose for every U, s in X(U), W→U, x in A(W), y in B(W), the localized maps a_U(s),b_U(s) agree on the section-map image of x tensor y. Then a=b. This tests localized pure tensors, not arbitrary global generation of sheaf tensor sections.

source.place: Section 03EK and Lemma 03EO; tensor and internal-Hom universal properties

proof.text: Form constant graded complexes with A and B in every degree and all differentials zero. The coproduct universal property gives a codiagonal π:T^0→A tensor B whose composite with every summand inclusion is identity.
Postcompose a,b by internalHom(π,id). Apply localized total-tensor extensionality; each summand restriction simplifies by the codiagonal identity to the given hypothesis.
Restrict the arguments along the (0,0) summand inclusion. Contravariant functoriality of internal Hom and the codiagonal identity recover a=b.

theorem homTensorSummandPure_ext (A B N X : Mod) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∀ (a b : X ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (A ⊗ B) N),
    (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : X.val.obj U) (W : (Over U.unop)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : A.val.obj (op W.unop.left)) (y : B.val.obj (op W.unop.left)),
      (((a.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
        (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y)) =
      (((b.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
        (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))) → a = b
